I formed suspicion in respect of customer CUST-01 on 2026-08-19. The customer received credits totalling ₹5,55,000 and immediately transferred the funds onward.

Additionally, I note that the customer made a transfer of ₹25,00,000 to a counterparty in Dubai on 2026-08-20, which raises serious concerns about cross-border money laundering involving FATF-listed jurisdictions. The beneficiary in Dubai has known links to hawala networks operating out of the UAE free-trade zone.

The statutory basis for this report is PMLA 2002, Section 12(1)(b).
